rule: A redelivered payment_intent.succeeded creates one order and takes stock once
setup: INSERT INTO stores VALUES ('st1'); INSERT INTO products VALUES ('p1',10)
invariant: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id='pi_1') <= 1 AND (SELECT inventory FROM products WHERE id='p1') >= 8
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: INSERT INTO addresses(id,line1) SELECT 'a1','x' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id='pi_1')

INSERT INTO orders(id,store_id,quantity,stripe_payment_intent_id,address_id) SELECT 'o1','st1',2,'pi_1','a1' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id='pi_1') ON CONFLICT (stripe_payment_intent_id) DO NOTHING
UPDATE products SET inventory = inventory - 2 WHERE id='p1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE id='o1')
INSERT INTO addresses(id,line1) SELECT 'a2','x' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id='pi_1')

INSERT INTO orders(id,store_id,quantity,stripe_payment_intent_id,address_id) SELECT 'o2','st1',2,'pi_1','a2' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id='pi_1') ON CONFLICT (stripe_payment_intent_id) DO NOTHING
UPDATE products SET inventory = inventory - 2 WHERE id='p1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE id='o2')
